test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of homonyms can be used to fill in the blanks most suitably?

The journalist was careful to ______ her sources, ensuring every statement could be traced to its original ______.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **cite, site**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"cite"** means to refer to or quote a source for information or evidence. (उल्लेख करना) • **Example:** The researcher was careful to cite all references in her paper. • The word **"site"** refers to a location, place, or area, often where an event occurs or something is situated. (स्थान) • **Example:** The construction site was inspected by the engineers before the work began. • Hence, in the given sentence, "cite" is used to indicate referencing sources, and "site" is used to refer to the location of those sources. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **cite, site**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: sight, site** (दृष्टि, स्थान) • **"Sight"** refers to the ability to see or something that is seen. (दृष्टि) • **Example:** The sight of the mountains was breathtaking. • **"Site"** refers to a location or place, as explained above. (स्थान) • **Example:** They visited the historical site during their trip. • However, this pair does not fit the sentence meaningfully. • **Option 2: site, cite** (स्थान, उल्लेख करना) • This pair reverses the correct order of "cite, site" and does not align with the intended meaning of the sentence. • **Option 3: cite, sight** (उल्लेख करना, दृष्टि) • **"Sight"** refers to vision or the ability to see, as explained above. (दृष्टि) • This pair does not fit the context of the sentence, as "sight" is unrelated to the idea of location. 4a:T92b, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Serious**.
